column1: # One row per bug class of docs/198_market_safety_positioning.md; checked by tests/counterexample_corpus_smoke.sh.

column4: The agent acting for tenant acme runs a charge step against tenant globex's account.
column7: message:resolves to non-authority slot 'agent' in zone 'GlobexTenant'
column12: Refused only when each tenant is its own zone type. Two instances of one TenantZone type are not told apart (a cross-tenant charge builds and runs); authorized-by resolves by slot name or unique subject type; the generated runtime check only tests that zone and participant are present (src/codegen/transpiler_block_intent_helpers.c:296-306). docs/196_content_instance_runtime_context.md:56.

column4: The agent's usage-charge step debits acme's account without the account owner's approval.
column7: message:cannot run in authority-bearing zone 'TenantZone' without 'authorized by'
column12: Checked on intent steps and zone rules only. A plain function calling the owner's Debit action builds and runs; 'authorized by' is a static attribution, no approval is obtained at run time.

column4: A guest asks the agent (deputy) to change acme's plan and the edit step is approved by the guest.
column7: message:resolves to non-authority slot 'guest' in zone 'AccountZone'
column12: Only the modeled shape is refused. Giving the deputy authority and writing 'authorized by: agent' builds and runs: there is no requester or delegation provenance (docs/semantics/01_intent_world_zone.md:23, docs/167_network_theory_application_map.md:116). The capability analog is enforced (PGY_SEM_EFFECT_CONFLICT).

column4: The support agent's turn is granted io_write only, but a context tool it calls reads a local file (io_read).
column9: accepted; bug at runtime (Node --permission is opt-in)
column12: Bounded only where 'with caps' is written (docs/semantics/15_capability_sandbox.md:102-103); without it the default grant reads, and only a host PGY_CAP_GRANT stops it at run time. Over-declaration is not reported at build time; no builtin carries NETWORK; an extern C call is admitted under unrelated caps.

column4: The agent turn spawns a background search tool call for acme and returns without awaiting it.
column12: Named spawn is enforced, but a detached async { } block that captures no locals is accepted and its work finishes after the caller returns (drained only at program exit). docs/196_content_instance_runtime_context.md:61-62.

column4: The user presses stop; the agent cancels the export tool call and reports it stopped without awaiting it.
column12: The check enforces the join after Cancel, not a prompt stop: cancellation is cooperative and the runtime cancellation tree is incomplete (docs/198_market_safety_positioning.md:35).

column4: The planner waits for the executor's capacity message while the executor waits for the plan first.
column9: accepted; bug at runtime (seen by a 2 s timer)
column10: accepted; bug at runtime (seen by a 2 s deadline)
column11: accepted; bug at runtime (seen by asyncio.timeout)
column12: No wait-cycle or deadlock detection exists at compile or run time. The opt-in wall-clock watchdog (PGY_BUDGET_WALL_MS) aborts with class=budget-exceeded; it is a time budget, not deadlock detection (docs/concurrency/advanced_examples.md:74).

column4: The agent releases the acme search tool handle, then a retried tool call still borrows and writes through it.
The agent fans out one summarize task per acme document (64, no cap) with every task in flight at once.
column12: The host has to opt in; there is no source-level budget (no budget keyword; effect-budget coupling unimplemented, docs/198_market_safety_positioning.md:34). The counter meters total spawns per process, not tasks in flight.

column4: The agent appends all 20000 search-hit ids to a result buffer although the request asks for 20.
column12: The host has to opt in and metering is incomplete: List<String> and StringConcat allocations are never charged (src/runtime/pgy_runtime_list_set_inline.h:197-255, src/runtime/pgy_runtime_string_builtin_inline.h:296), so the same storm with strings runs to the end under the same limit.

column4: One agent request busy-polls the host clock until a deadline, millions of calls per run.
column12: No host-call budget: the budget kinds are alloc bytes, alloc count, spawn and channel (src/runtime/pgy_runtime_budget.h:35-41); a capability is one bit, unlimited once granted. Only the wall-clock watchdog stops it, on time. The fixed version's limit is ordinary user code.

column4: The agent retries a paid model call until it succeeds, spending 1200 cents against a 10-cent budget.
column12: No network or cost budget: PGY_CAP_NETWORK has no runtime require site; 'consumes NetworkBudget' is a proposal (docs/198_market_safety_positioning.md:171-178); retry/timeout/backoff do not execute (docs/199_language_word_and_dogfood_grammar.md:75). The fixed version's limit is ordinary user code.

column4: The agent's checkout tool creates a Payment for acme and calls Capture before Authorize.
column7: message:Lifecycle violation: 'Capture' on 'payment' is not permitted in state 'Pending'
column12: The static check covers governed locals within one function (src/semantic/lifecycle_analyze.c:8-11); a Payment received as a parameter is checked neither at compile time nor at run time (docs/semantics/12_domain_lifecycle_evidence.md:141-143). Ambiguous joins get a runtime guard. The step dependency DAG (INT-3) is not implemented.

column4: The agent's purchase intent debits acme's wallet, then the ship step is refused because the warehouse has no stock.
column12: Compensation (reverse-order undo under rollback: full), not atomicity: the debit is visible until the refund runs, and only steps written as an intent with compensate: are covered; the same logic as plain functions keeps the debit.

column4: The purchase intent declares rollback: full, but its debit step has no compensate: while the later ship step can fail.
column12: The obligation exists only when the intent claims full rollback; an intent with neither rollback nor compensation is accepted and keeps the debit (docs/173_intent_axis_strengthening.md:198-206). Native pipeline only; the self-host parser rejects 'irreversible'.

column4: The agent binds world.tools to a local, the world rotates the tool zone to globex, then the agent records a call through the old handle.
column12: Compile-time escape refusal covers local, argument and return carriage. The runtime generation check only warns ('stale zone layer read') and continues (src/runtime/pgy_runtime_zone_result_option_inline.h:24-48).
